bindings.statement: For the static-plus-harmonic Physlib ensemble, the temperature derivative of actual molar enthalpy along a local stable constant-pressure branch equals the OMAI Cp identity. Cv, volume, expansion and isothermal bulk modulus must belong to the same molar free-energy surface.

Temperature T and primitive-cell volume v are positive. Every frequency is positive and C2 on an open positive-volume domain. Static energy E_0(v) is C2, arbitrary signed, and independent of temperature.
Keep masses, composition, atom and q counts, reduced-q labels, uniform q weights and Avogadro scale fixed. Frequencies depend on volume but have no independent temperature dependence.

Use molar volume V_m=N_A*v. Let F_static_joint be the actual free energy after attaching the N_q*E_0(v) singleton, and F_harmonic_joint the unshifted harmonic free energy. Then F_mol=(N_A/N_q)*F_static_joint=N_A*E_0(v)+(N_A/N_q)*F_harmonic_joint. Evaluate all quantities at the same temperature and equilibrium volume, per mole of the same primitive cells, not per mole of atoms.

The supplied volume path is differentiable at the evaluation temperature and satisfies domain membership and F_V+p_ext=0 throughout a neighborhood, with constant external pressure. Require F_VV>0 at the evaluation point; the proved C2 regularity permits restriction to a stable neighborhood. A pointwise stationarity equation alone is insufficient.

Interpret expansion as V_m_prime/V_m and bulk modulus as the isothermal derivative V_m*F_VV. Cp is the derivative of actual molar internal energy plus p_ext*V_m along that path; Cv is the fixed-volume capacity of the same actual ensemble.

conventions.normalization_basis: Moles of primitive cells. The Hamiltonian static offset is N_q*E_0(v); N_A/N_q is applied to evaluated thermodynamic quantities, giving N_A*E_0(v) in molar F and U. There is no branch-count divisor.
conventions.frequency_convention: Angular SI frequency with exact upstream hbar and kB. Stored linear THz requires omega_SI=2*pi*10^12*nu_THz; finite-precision conversion code is not certified.
conventions.unit_embedding: F and U in J/mol, capacities J/(mol K), primitive-cell v in m^3 and molar V_m in m^3/mol; pressure and isothermal bulk modulus in Pa. Use a common numeric-unit embedding, not raw mixed serving values.
conventions.held_fixed: Composition, masses, q labels/weights, Avogadro scale and the static-energy/frequency functions are fixed. Cv differentiates at fixed volume; Cp differentiates along the locally constant-pressure path.
conventions.admissibility: T>0, v>0, omega>0, N_A>0, N_q>0 and local positive isothermal curvature. Totalized values outside the model domain have no asserted physical interpretation.
conventions.reference_energy: All oscillator zero-point energies remain. The signed temperature-independent static energy enters the actual Hamiltonian and is not silently removed.
conventions.qpoint_weighting: Uniform full-grid q averaging; varying primitive volume does not change reduced-q labels or introduce fractional oscillator copies.

remaining_obligations: Static-energy, phonon, geometry, thermal-expansion and bulk-modulus producers are interpreted inputs, not verified implementations. The theorem does not validate EOS fits, minimizers, finite-difference/polyfit derivatives or the sibling compute_heat_capacity_p producer.

The equilibrium branch and common-potential input interpretation remain explicit local hypotheses of the general theorem. The compiled nonzero-expansion and zero-response witnesses establish realizable model examples; they do not certify any particular material or numerical volume scan.
Zero or imaginary modes, independent temperature-dependent spectra, nonuniform q quadrature, intermode coupling, phase coexistence and mechanically unstable branches remain outside scope.
No claim is made about FC3 mode gammas or the opaque thermal-Gruneisen producer. A fitted thermodynamic quotient is not independent evidence for mode-weighted gamma agreement.

bindings.statement: The sum of actual Physlib single-mode heat capacities divided by N_q*V_cell, with positive primitive-cell volume V_cell, equals the OMAI volumetric heat-capacity formula. The same grid satisfies C_vol=C_mol/(N_A*V_cell).
conditions: Use a finite grid Fin N_q x Fin (3*N_atoms), with positive natural N_q and N_atoms. Fin labels map to OMAI 1-based labels by i.val+1.
Each grid entry is an upstream positive-frequency harmonic oscillator with exact upstream hbar and kB; all entries share one positive absolute temperature.
All modes must have strictly positive frequencies. An unmodified Gamma grid with zero acoustic modes does not satisfy the premises.
Hold the mode spectrum, weights and primitive-cell basis fixed; convert stored linear THz to angular frequency.
V_cell is the positive primitive-cell volume in m^3, not a supercell volume; convert stored Angstrom^3 by the exact factor 10^-30.
Use sum(c)/(N_q*V_cell), with no Avogadro factor or branch-count divisor. The molar comparison uses the same positive N_A and primitive-cell basis.

conventions.component_scope: N_q q points and exactly 3*N_atoms branches per primitive-cell basis.
